description: LK holds 42 text rows (letters in both cases, a-umlaut, ae-ligature, digits, a*c, a?c, a#c, a[c, a]c, a-c, a!c, a^c, single wildcard characters, trailing and leading spaces, empty, Null). Which ids match each bracket form (ascending id), with error numbers where refused: [a-c], [!a-c], [^a-c], [ab], [!ab], a trailing and a leading hyphen, a reversed range, two ranges and a hyphen, two ranges together, a class inside a pattern (positive and negated), classes holding *, ?, #, -, a negated hyphen, an open bracket and a close bracket, and a negated close bracket? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
